headline: Fireworks AI hack exposed Notion chat transcripts; Apify rotates tokens after breach; N-central and ScreenConnect attacks continue

bullets.text: New: TechCrunch reports the Fireworks AI cyberattack let hackers access Notion customers' chat transcripts, widening earlier reports that Notion customer data was compromised (7 outlets).

New: Apify is rotating API tokens and prompting 2FA resets after a breach (BleepingComputer). Separately, SecurityWeek reports an attacker targeting 60,000 GitHub repositories in a credential theft campaign.

The Hacker News reports new N-central exploits that work against patched servers, giving root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access. This follows attacks on N-central zero-days as N-able rushed patches (3 outlets).

The Register reports a ScreenConnect plugin flaw being exploited to spread malware across hundreds of PCs; related ScreenConnect attacks breached MSPs and affected dozens of organizations (5 outlets).

KEV due today (11-12): GPUStack CVE-2026-102895 (SANS sees exploit attempts), OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779, Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218. Due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560, Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935.

New: The Record says hijacked email accounts are complicating investigations into European bomb hoaxes. Also on the board: Xen Orchestra and Cisco BroadWorks exploitation, Vanderbilt ransomware lockdown (6 outlets). SITCON 3 at 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Fireworks AI / Notion AI users: review what data was sent through these services and rotate any secrets that appeared in chats.
Apify users: rotate API tokens, reset 2FA as prompted, and review recent actor runs; check GitHub CI secrets for signs of theft.
N-central: do not rely on patches alone; take consoles off the internet now and hunt for root or SYSTEM-level compromise.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and plugins, remove unknown clients and plugins, and hunt for malware pushed through sessions.
Finish GPUStack, OpenSSH, FreeSwitch and Aspera Faspex KEV fixes today; patch Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure by 11-13.
Schedule Outlook, Chromium and Cisco BroadWorks KEV fixes before 11-24; keep Xen Orchestra management off the open internet.
